name: simple-ldap-login
description: WordPress authentication for Active Directory and OpenLDAP.
author: Clif Griffin Development Inc.

scripts.lint:js: wp-scripts lint-js assets/admin.js scripts/package.cjs tests/package.cjs tests/admin-js.cjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:css && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:pkg-json
scripts.test:docker: npm run build:free && npm run build:pro && npm run build:legacy && npm run build:transition && sh tests/docker/run.sh test
scripts.test:release: composer check && npm run lint && npm run test:admin && npm run test:packages && sh tests/docker/matrix.sh
scripts.env:up: npm run build:free && npm run build:pro && npm run build:legacy && npm run build:transition && sh tests/docker/run.sh up
